title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：thinking　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thinking 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the elder ① shared the thinking that no youth in the village would have recorded, and he said the sharing was the whole of the year. The ② thinking, meaning the thought itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; thinking, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ bit of thinking in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ thinking at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Thinking, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the elder said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the thinking was the whole of the matter, meaning the wisdom and not the thought. The ⑥ thinking, meaning the wisdom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; thinking, he said, is either something you share or the only word that means both thought and a wisdom. He said the wisdom is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ thinking had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ thinking of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of recording; thinking, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ thinking I remember is the thinking recorded in the memoir, which closed in 1963 and is still recorded as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Thinking, my mother said in 1965, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all thinking, she said, is a wisdom that has agreed to look like thought. She said the wisdom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 想法；思考（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 想法；思考（指那种想法本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：share the thinking 说出这一种想法
D. n. 想法；思考（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 想法之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的想法之事）
F. n. 想法；思考（指回忆录里写到、被记载的那一种）
G. n. 想法、见识（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 见识（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: share the thinking 意为“说出这一种想法”，1956 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记载的一种想法做了一遍。
thinking 意为“想法；思考”，指那种想法本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
thinking 意为“想法；思考”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
thinking 意为“想法；思考”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
thinking 意为“想法、见识”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种见识就是那件事的全部。
thinking 意为“见识”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种想法，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
thinking 意为“想法；思考”，指回忆录里写到、被记载的那一种，到 1961 年这一种成了回忆录里的一行。
thinking 意为“想法之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的想法之事是一处村子和三个年头的记载。
thinking 意为“想法；思考”，我记得的是回忆录里记载过的那一种，1963 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一种。
thinking 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，想法是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的想法。
